blurb: Guests cruise aboard two identical 113-foot modern yachts licensed by Transport Canada, hosting up to 280 guests. The yachts feature a main deck with a fully equipped bar and climate-controlled interior, and an upper deck with 360-degree views of the Toronto skyline. Amenities include modern sound and lighting systems, lounge and dining areas, and full washroom facilities.

quotes.text: Thank you for making our day perfect. Bill and I were thrilled with the venue and your touches, and our guests are still talking about it. Your staff was exceptionally helpful to our elderly and ill family members. The food, flowers, and décor were everything I’d hoped for, and most of all, you made my day stress-free and enjoyable

I would like to rate everything 10 / 10. It was absolutely wonderful! Everyone went above and beyond. We will certainly contact you again for our next cruise. And I will definitely recommend Yankee Lady to anyone looking for a great event. Thanks again for everything.

Just a heartfelt thank you to everyone who made our celebration so extraordinary! The preparation, energy, and care you put into every aspect truly shone through. We felt completely supported and relaxed, and our guests had the best time.
Just a short note to thank you for taking such care… on our wedding day. The preparation and energy you poured into this celebration is not lost on us, and we are so grateful and thankful!
The venue was breathtaking! Every corner was picture-perfect and created an incredible ambiance for our wedding. The food was delicious and being on the water made it even better.
